title: Accounts, optional 2FA, OAuth, and persistent session history

close_reason: Email/password accounts, optional TOTP, Google/GitHub/Proton OAuth hooks, and per-user SQLite generation history.

title: Add Grok Imagine image models and generation client
description:
Why: Catalog image models are SeeDream-only (4). xAI lists grok-imagine-image-2.0 (recommended), grok-imagine-image, and grok-imagine-image-quality. Live inventory currently classifies grok-imagine-image as video because 'imagine' matches the video overlay first. get_image_generator rejects grok.

What:
- Add grok-imagine-image-2.0, grok-imagine-image, grok-imagine-image-quality, grok-imagine-video (legacy)
- GrokImageClient POST /v1/images/generations (and /edits with refs)
- Factory + /api/images/generate uses XAI_API_KEY for grok
- Infer grok-imagine-image as category=image
- Studio payload provider=grok for those models

Acceptance: catalog lists grok image models; generate with grok uses XAI key; infer_model_capabilities('grok-imagine-image') is image.
close_reason: Added grok-imagine-image-2.0, grok-imagine-image, grok-imagine-image-quality, grok-imagine-video; GrokImageClient; factory and /api/images/generate use XAI_API_KEY; infer treats grok-imagine-image as image.

title: Coding workspace: attach folder and path jail

title: Coding tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Bash
description: Implement Claude Code-shaped tools, enforced by the harness not the prompt. Read/Glob/Grep: auto-ok inside workspace. Write/Edit: exact-string Edit like Claude Code (old_string/new_string), Write for new files. Bash: cwd=workspace, timeout, captured stdout/stderr — not a PTY. Deny paths outside root even if the model asks.

title: Coding Tool: Claude Code-inspired local agent
description: Local console service: attach a folder, chat with a tool-using agent that edits that tree, and run commands in that cwd. Inspired by Claude Code’s harness (workspace, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/Bash, permission modes) — not a clone of the closed-source engine, MCP, subagents, or PTY. New src/coding/ package and a dedicated UI view; do not grow ui/app.html further.

What:

- /api/health for compose healthchecks
- docker/api.Dockerfile, docker/web.Dockerfile, nginx, compose
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (test + docker build)
- Keep make dev as the single-process local studio

Acceptance: pytest passes; SERVE_UI=0 does not serve HTML; docker compose build succeeds; CI workflow present.
close_reason: API/UI split at the container boundary: SERVE_UI=0, /api/health, docker compose (api+nginx), GitHub Actions pytest+image build. Images built locally; API smoke test: health 200, / 404.

title: Test coverage analysis
description: Measure pytest coverage across src/, identify uncovered modules and gaps, add coverage tooling if missing, and file follow-up issues for high-value untested code.
notes: Baseline (working tree 2026-09-21): 52 tests, all passing. Line coverage 69% (760/1102 stmts) including uncommitted SeeDream. Committed src/ without seedream was 73% (731/999). Gaps: cli.py 0%, grok/client.py 20%, seedream/client.py 17%, planner.py 45% (class methods 0%), qa/audit.py 47%, seedance 82%, server 86%, inventory 91%, models_registry 97%. Remotion has no tests.
